title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19
lineage: Anne Cohen : AD Transfer - Master Cassettes played on Nakamichi Dragon > HHB CDR830Plus > CD Ohr : CD > EAC > WAV > FLAC
source: Master Audience Cassettes - recorded by Ohr Weinberg: 2 Sony ECM-23F microphones > Sony TC-D5M Cassette Deck (1st & 2nd Sets: Maxell XLII-S 90 Cassettes), Dolby B

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an early‑80s show, highlighted by smooth second‑set transitions and classic Dead fun.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the balanced, crystal‑clear recording supplied by Ohr Weinberg, calling it one of the most perfect auds available. The performance itself is praised for its enjoyable vibe and especially the first four tunes of the second set, whose transitions are described as “really great,” even if the era’s typical quirks (“warts”) remain.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed, highly positive reviews emphasize superb recording quality and an enjoyable show despite minor period‑specific imperfections.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Balanced, crisp, and perfect‑sounding audio as highlighted by multiple reviewers; no noted flaws in the mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers note especially strong transitions between the first four tunes of the second set, describing the overall vibe as fun and engaging despite typical early‑80s “warts.”
